title: Game buyout
author: Optimal-Community-21
selftext:
Hi

I am looking to video game code for some ai work I'm doing. I have a large budget for quality code and associated IP.

1) ideally if the game was published and has/had a user base. 

2) not generated by AI or had any significant ai generated code.

3) code is not publicly available. 

If you can link me to your project/store listing etc I'm happy to give an offer.

replies.author: Optimal-Community-21
replies.body: I just want to buy a codebase of no generated video game code that isn't ai generated and had some customer base now or in the past.

replies.author: re-skob
replies.body: yeah, this is probably a scammer who is trying to buy failed projects for cheap to have them install malware. Saw a video for a scam like this a few weeks back but can't find it now.

replies.author: Optimal-Community-21
replies.body: No I have an ai project that requires training data.  It's an opportunity for devs to make money on old game code or something that isn't growing. Not sure why this sounds suspicious.

replies.body: Someone suggested it on a different sub reddit so just cross posted. Doesn't cost anything to ask

comments.author: RickRelentless
comments.body: Smells like one of those “buy the source code of published game, add malware, publish compromised version as an update on Steam, try to steal player’s data” schemes
